company_source.quote: E: FN), a leading provider of advanced optical packaging and precision optical, electro-mechanical and electronic manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers of complex products, today announced it will release financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended September 25, 2026 , after market close on Monday, November 2, 2026 .
company_source.title: Fabrinet to Announce First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on November 2, 2026
